finding: For every all-Hurwitz independent monic septic box, any weak odd-canceling/Vieta no-go with at most five retained positive finite frequencies and optional infinity must have at least one node in the second global odd-root band [c,d] OR at least two distinct nodes in the third odd-root band [e,f]. If neither occurs, the minimal-pair theorem reduces the no-go to two four-node infinity circuits; odd sign ordering forces each circuit's first two nodes into the first odd band, its third before c and its fourth outside (c,d). The common vertex (-t)(c-t)(d-t) then has positive even pairing on both circuits by the earlier corrected theorem. This is an all-box necessary condition, not existence or exclusion of certificates satisfying it and not a direct strict-negative-coordinate theorem.
